# **ZENESYS \- 2026**

## ERP OLYMPICS INTERNAL HACKATHON

*Build. Compete. Get Discovered.*

Zenesys 2026 is the official internal hackathon at GH Raisoni College of Engineering and Management, organized by the Comet Club under the Computer Department in collaboration with Suitepedia. This event serves as the exclusive qualifying round for the ERP Olympics 2026\.

The event is designed as an intensive 12-hour build experience where teams transform a given enterprise problem into a functional technology solution. The top-performing teams will earn the opportunity to advance to the 48-hour ERP Olympics 2026 and represent GHRCEM Pune on the global stage.

## EVENT OVERVIEW

* **Date:** 22 August 2026  
* **Venue:** GHRCEM Pune Campus  
* **Duration:** 12 Hours Total (8 Hours Build Phase | 4 Hours External Evaluation)  
* **Registration Deadline:** 22 August 2026 (Before Kickoff)  
* **Team Size:** 2 to 4 members per team  
* **Key Domains:** Enterprise Technology, NetSuite, ERP, AI & Automation Solutions

Registration Portal \- [https://luma.com/y21u4rur](https://luma.com/y21u4rur)

# ROUND 1: DETAILED EVENT FLOW

### 1\. Kickoff and Registration

Teams complete final check-in and registration before the competition begins. The organizers will introduce the challenge, competition rules, submission requirements, and the evaluation process.

### 2\. 8-Hour Coding Sprint

Teams work intensively on their solutions within the targeted domains (Enterprise Technology, NetSuite, ERP, AI & Automation Solutions). During the sprint, teams are expected to:

* Develop a functional solution.  
* Test and refine their implementation.  
* Work within the given problem constraints.  
* Prepare their deployment and demonstration.  
* Resolve technical challenges within the competition period.

### 3\. Coding Ends

At the end of the 8-hour development period, coding officially stops. Teams must finalize their submission, documentation, deployment, and presentation materials.

### 4\. External Evaluation

Teams present their working solutions to the external evaluation panel.

### 5\. Final Selection

The judging panel evaluates the participating teams, and the top-performing teams are officially selected for progression to the global ERP Olympics 2026\.

# TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS & JUDGING CRITERIA

## TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

* **Platform Neutral:** Teams may use any suitable technology stack. No specific programming language, framework, ERP, or platform is strictly mandatory.  
    
* **ERP and Development Platforms:** Commercial ERP (such as NetSuite), open-source ERP, custom applications, and low-code or no-code platforms may be used.  
*   
* **Technologies:** Teams may use APIs, cloud services, databases, AI and ML frameworks, RPA, analytics, and third-party integrations where relevant.  
    
* **AI Usage:** AI-assisted development and AI-based features are permitted. Teams must explicitly disclose the AI tools used and explain how they contributed to the final solution.

* **Originality:** The core solution must be developed by the participating team *during* the hackathon. Pre-built solutions or substantially completed projects submitted as new work are not permitted.


## JUDGING CRITERIA

The external evaluation will score teams based on a structured rubric to ensure fairness and quality:

* **Innovation:** Creativity and originality of the solution in addressing the enterprise problem.  
    
* **Technical Execution:** Code quality, system architecture, and overall engineering stability.  
    
* **Functionality & Completeness:** How well the working prototype operates and solves the core constraint.  
    
* **Real-World Impact:** The potential business value, feasibility, and scalability of the solution in an enterprise setting.  
    
* **User Experience:** Design, accessibility, and ease of use for the end-user.  
    
* **Use of Emerging Technology:** Effective implementation of AI, automation, or advanced enterprise frameworks.  
    
* **Presentation & Team Collaboration:** Clarity of the pitch, documentation, and the team's ability to cohesively explain their product.


# RULES, PRIZES & RECOGNITION

## RULES AND REGULATIONS

* Teams must consist of strictly 2 to 4 members, and registration must be completed before kickoff.  
* At least 50% of the team members must remain present in the working area at all times; absence may result in score deduction.  
* No eatables are allowed in the working areas (labs).  
* Playing music or engaging in any activity that disturbs others is strictly prohibited.  
* Participants are responsible for any damage to college property and must bear the costs.  
* Leaving the premises, engaging in unethical practices, or bringing disruptive items may lead to immediate disqualification.  
* The decision of the organizing committee will be final.

## PRIZES & RECOGNITION

* **Winning Teams:** Exclusive Zenesys merchandise and recognition for the top-performing teams.  
* **All Participants:** Official participation certificates for everyone who completes the competition.  
* **Professional Recognition:** LinkedIn recognition for participants and winning teams.  
* **Global Opportunity:** The top teams qualify to represent GHRCEM at the ERP Olympics 2026\.


### **PHASE 2: ERP OLYMPICS 2026 (GLOBAL STAGE)**

* **48-Hour Global Hackathon:** Take your skills from the GHRCEM campus to a massive international competition.  
* **$1,500 Prize Pool:** Compete for a massive global prize pool.  
* **Internships & Placements:** Top performers can compete for guaranteed internship and placement opportunities with participating sponsors, including ParrotAI and others.  
* **Global Recognition:** Showcase your solution and technical capabilities to a premier international technology community.


### **GET READY TO BUILD.**

**12 HOURS. ONE CHALLENGE. ONE SOLUTION.**  
Bring your team, your skills, and your ideas. Build something that stands out at Zenesys 2026 and earn your opportunity to take GHRCEM Pune to the ERP Olympics global stage.
